ABOUT THESE RESULTS
Sources & methodology
This dashboard tracks 13 Senate and 8 House races relevant to Associated Builders and Contractors, plus nationwide chamber control.
Live data. Connect an authorized full-snapshot JSON feed in Data connection. The dashboard polls every 30 seconds while open. Source timestamps are shown in Eastern Time. Feeds more than two minutes old are marked stale; failed refreshes retain the last successful results with a warning.
Race calls. Only explicit calls from the feed are displayed. Leading in votes or reaching 100% reporting does not automatically call a race. Race calls are projections, and results remain unofficial until certified.
Chamber control. Seat totals must include seats not up for election, winners called nationwide, and independents according to their caucus. Totals are never inferred from this priority-race list. The House has 435 seats and an outright majority is 218. The Senate has 100 seats; 51 is an outright majority, while a 50–50 split depends on the vice president’s tie-breaking vote. Control is shown only when the source explicitly calls it.
Vote in. The estimated percentage counted comes directly from the feed and may change. The margin uses votes for all supplied candidates. Blank values mean no data has been supplied.
Demo mode. All candidates, vote totals, seat counts, and calls in demo mode are fictional. Demo data is never combined with live data.
